name: Graphiti
ontology_notes: Built-in types are Entity nodes, EntityEdge facts (RELATES_TO), Episodic nodes (raw ingest), MENTIONS edges, Community nodes, and optional custom Pydantic entity/edge types. Episodes are text, message (speaker: message), or json. group_id namespaces a graph. There are no first-class companion kinds. A developer can prescribe Person/Character types, but the default learned ontology is generic entities and facts.

ontology.evidence: README and help.getzep.com/graphiti/getting-started/overview.md name entities, facts/relationships, episodes, communities, and custom types. custom-entity-and-edge-types.md lets you pass Pydantic models into add_episode. Companion roles are not shipped as types.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: add_episode extracts entities and edges via LLM from episode_body. add_triplet writes facts directly. add_episode_bulk skips edge invalidation. MCP add_episode is the assistant-facing write. The library does not refuse intimate or adversarial text.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: working-with-data/searching.md: graphiti.search is hybrid semantic+BM25 with RRF; optional focal_node_uuid distance rerank; graphiti._search plus SearchConfig recipes. The app decides what to put in the prompt. No social silence. group_id limits the search space.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: README: when information changes, old facts are invalidated, not deleted. EntityEdge in graphiti_core/edges.py has valid_at, invalid_at, expired_at, and reference_time. Bulk ingest docs warn that add_episode_bulk does not invalidate.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: README describes bi-temporal tracking and point-in-time queries. add_episode takes reference_time. EntityEdge.valid_at is when the fact became true; invalid_at is when it stopped; expired_at is when it was invalidated in the graph.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: graph-namespacing.md isolates tenants with group_id. That is one bag per namespace unless the developer defines custom entity types. No built-in user vs character vs relationship split.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: SearchFilters can restrict node_labels and edge_types. That is ontology filtering, not a control to suppress a relevant fact for social reasons.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: README: every entity and relationship traces to episodes. That is provenance, not a write filter. Retrieved facts are prompt text with no trust tag. MCP can add_episode from the model.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: CRUD docs and Edge.delete hard-delete nodes/edges. MCP delete_episode and clear_graph exist. Invalidation preserves history rather than erasing. No user-facing forget-that that also hides invalidated edges from search unless the caller filters on invalid_at.
forgetting.label: inferred

cost_shape.evidence: Ingest uses LLM structured output per episode (entity extract, edge extract, invalidation) plus embeddings for names and facts. README retrieval is hybrid search without LLM summarization; optional cross-encoder rerank adds a model call. SEMAPHORE_LIMIT defaults to 10 concurrent LLM ops. Docs claim LoCoMo retrieval 155ms and LongMemEval 162ms.
cost_shape.label: inferred

local.evidence: Apache-2.0 graphiti-core. Runs on Neo4j, FalkorDB, or Neptune with a local or remote LLM. Intimate chat can stay on one machine if those services do. Default path still wants an OpenAI-compatible structured-output model.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official experimental server in getzep/graphiti mcp_server. Docs at help.getzep.com/graphiti/getting-started/mcp-server.md. Tools include add_episode, search_facts, search_nodes, get_episodes, delete_episode, clear_graph.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Validity windows are the strongest companion-relevant mechanism in this slice (old home, old partner, time skip). The product is still a generic temporal KG for agents. Prompt assembly, companion ontology, silence, and poisoning filters are the app's job. Hybrid retrieve-into-prompt is the remember path.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo, LongMemEval
published_eval.claimed_score: Graphiti-based retrieval 94.7% accuracy at 155ms on LoCoMo; 90.2% at 162ms on LongMemEval (overview.md).
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Conversational fact recall (LoCoMo single/multi-hop/temporal; LongMemEval assistant long-context QA). Not character drift, social silence, or persona poisoning.

open_unknowns: Exact LLM call graph inside add_episode (how many structured-output calls per episode in current graphiti_core).
Whether default search excludes invalid_at edges or returns them unless the caller filters.
How the 94.7 / 90.2 numbers were measured (model, top-k, whether this is Graphiti OSS or Zep-hosted).
